comments.why: Standardized simple interface of character LCDs
comments.text: If you don't need actual HDMI and a regular monitor then there are other solutions which are more like what you describe: Firstly there are simple character LCDs which all have a standardized and simple electrical interface[1] for sending ASCII characters and control codes. Then there are bit-addressable colour displays that let you send drawing commands, eg: [2] [3] [4] [1] [VIDEO] [2] [LINK] [3] [LINK] [4] [LINK]
